lines.text: Paul found disciples in Ephesus with John's baptism, and the Holy Spirit came when he laid hands on them.
Paul held daily discussions in Tyrannus's lecture hall for two years, and everyone in Asia heard the word.
Seven sons of Sceva tried to command an evil spirit by Jesus and fled the temple naked and wounded.
Fear came over all in Ephesus, and a number of those who had practiced magic arts burned their books.
